verdict.rationale: Zapier's docs say users can describe what they need in plain language and their AI client calls the right Zapier action across 9,000+ apps via Zapier MCP, with prompt-driven examples like booking a meeting. Zapier Copilot also helps users create agents conversationally, and AI generates troubleshooting instructions. missing for 10: evidence that core Zap workflow building and editing can be driven by natural language (Copilot is documented only for agents), detailed docs on the NL command experience, independent or hands-on corroboration.
